mapper.select: select g.game_id , g.date , g.home_score , g.away_score , g.result, g.round, h.team_id as home_team_id, h.name as home_team_name, h.logo as home_team_logo, a.team_id as away_team_Id, a.name as away_team_name, a.logo as away_team_logo from game g join team h on g.home_api_id = h.team_id join team a on g.away_api_id = a.team_id;

select g.game_id , g.date , g.home_score , g.away_score , g.result, g.round, h.team_id as home_team_id, h.name as home_team_name, h.logo as home_team_logo, a.team_id as away_team_Id, a.name as away_team_name, a.logo as away_team_logo from game g join team h on g.home_api_id = h.team_id join team a on g.away_api_id = a.team_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(g.`date`, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{date}

select g.game_id , g.date , g.home_score , g.away_score , g.result, g.round, h.team_id as home_team_id, h.name as home_team_name, h.logo as home_team_logo, a.team_id as away_team_id, a.name as away_team_name, a.logo as away_team_logo from game g join team h on g.home_api_id = h.team_id join team a on g.away_api_id = a.team_id where g.game_id = #{gameId};
